entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-kit#search
entry.summary: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card. Exact install spec: github:hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#path:/packages/search. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
